ai_rules.danisman_sarti: There is no advisor requirement. Pilots compete individually.
oncelikli_gorevler: Navigate a challenging FPV drone race track at a partially active airport.
Achieve the fastest 3 consecutive laps during qualification.
Win the double-elimination bracket in the finals (Chase the Ace).
sartname_kisitlari_ve_yasaklar: Drone Size & Battery: Framesize must be 4" - 6". Batteries up to 6S.

VTx Rules: 25mW output limit. Only Analog and HDZero are allowed. VTx MUST be controllable via the remote (for PitMode/channel switching). Increasing output power beyond 25mW leads to disqualification.
RC Link Rules: Crossfire MUST be set to 868MHz (Turkey uses 900MHz for GSM). 2.4GHz links (ELRS/Tracer/Ghost) must be set to 25mW with dynamic power turned OFF.
Track Rules: Obstacles must be passed in the correct order and side. Missed obstacles must be re-passed.
Safety (Failsafe): If safety is jeopardized due to video loss or failsafe, the pilot must land or crash immediately on the spot, without crossing the flying field.
Unsportsmanlike Conduct: Any insult, discrimination, or physical/psychological pressure leads to disciplinary action/disqualification.

criteria.name: Frame Size and Battery Check
criteria.description: Check if drone dimensions and power source match the rules.
guiding_questions: Is the frame size between 4" and 6"? Are the batteries 6S or below?

criteria.name: VTx and RC Link Settings
criteria.description: Strict check on video and radio transmission powers.
guiding_questions: HAKEM KONTROLÜ (KRİTİK): Is the VTx set to 25mW? Is it strictly Analog or HDZero? Can the pilot switch to PitMode via their radio?
HAKEM KONTROLÜ (KRİTİK): Is Crossfire set to 868MHz? If 2.4GHz is used, is dynamic power OFF and locked to 25mW?

criteria.name: LEDs and Failsafe
guiding_questions: Does the drone correctly cut motors upon signal loss (failsafe)? (LEDs are optional but recommended).

criteria.name: Fastest-3-Consecutive (Qualifying)
criteria.description: Pilot's best 3 consecutive laps in a 120s window.
guiding_questions: What is the pilot's best 3 consecutive lap time? Did the pilot skip any obstacles without returning?

criteria.name: Double Elimination & Chase the Ace
guiding_questions: Did the pilot advance through the double-elimination bracket? In 'Chase the Ace', did the pilot achieve the required two wins?
In case of a crash or DNF, who passed the most gates or traveled further?
